---
title: "If the China ‘Bubble’ Bursts…"
date: "2010-12-23"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

[International Economy](http://www.international-economy.com/TIE_F10_ChinaBubbleSymp.pdf "International Economy") poses the somewhat loaded question to 30 pundits, including my CIS colleague John Lee. My answer would be ‘go back and look what happened in 1998-99.’ China has grown in importance since, not least to Australia, but Australia has already weathered a scenario in which East Asia and commodity prices crashed.
